hero.tagline: I build fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses and people who need to be found online.

about.title: About
about.bio: I am a Full-Stack Web Developer and Software Engineering student in Aba, Abia State, Nigeria. I build clean, quick websites that work well on a phone and that customers can use to call, book or order on WhatsApp.

build.title: Build
build.text: React and Tailwind interfaces that load fast and read well on small screens.

business.title: Business sites
business.text: Websites for shops and services, with prices, opening hours and WhatsApp contact built in.

ship.title: Ship
ship.text: Projects go live on Vercel straight from GitHub, so changes reach visitors in minutes.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Two live websites I designed and built.

barbershop.summary: A website for a barbershop. It lists services and prices in Naira, shows opening hours, and lets a customer pick a time and send the booking on WhatsApp.

pentecost.summary: A website for a phones and accessories shop at Emeka Offor Plaza, Main Market. Customers browse products, tap one to ask for the price on WhatsApp, and find the shop on the map.

footer.title: Get in touch
footer.text: Have a website in mind? Send me a message and I will reply as soon as I can.

meta.title: Kelly Billionz | Full-Stack Web Developer in Aba, Abia State
meta.description: Amalunwoke Akachukwu (Kelly Billionz) is a Full-Stack Web Developer in Aba, Abia State, Nigeria. See his projects and get in touch.
